jobs.title: Business Resilience Officer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Business Resilience Officer (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

As Business Resilience Officer, you will be part of the Clearstream Securities Services (CSS) Business Resilience function within the Independent Business Risk and Control (IBRC) area, supporting the governance of first line of defence (1LoD) risk and control practices, with a focus on strengthening the effectiveness, quality and efficiency of the internal control environment.

In this role, you will support the team in connecting processes, risks, controls, findings, incidents, claims and remediation activities into a single risk-resilience cycle. You will contribute to a robust, proportionate and fit-for-purpose Internal Control System (ICS), while building your analytical skills and progressively adopting data, automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities under the guidance of more experienced colleagues.

Your responsibilities:

• Support ICS quality and efficiency: Perform analysis on the quality, adequacy, completeness and consistency of CSS processes, risks and controls, and support continuous improvements towards proportionate, balanced and efficient ICS key controls.
• Support audit and supervisory remediation: Assist in the coordination of regulatory onsite inspections and in the tracking of significant internal, statutory and regulatory findings, including support to evidence collection, Corrective Action Plan (CAP) documentation and remediation progress monitoring.
• Assist external assurance coordination: Support ISAE 3402 and SOC 2 audit work, including preparation of documentation, drafting of observations, follow-up on improvement measures and liaison with the external auditor under the supervision of more senior team members.
• Contribute to integrated control reporting: Support connecting-the-dots analysis and reporting across internal and external findings, Self-Identified Issues (SII), claims and goodwill, and incidents, helping to provide a comprehensive view of control maturity, failure events and actionable remediation; contribute to the Annual Management Report on Internal Controls.
• Support SII and CAP lifecycle management: Assist in the identification of SIIs and associated CAPs, help maintain the inventory, monitor remediation progress and support transparent reporting.
• Contribute to the risk-resilience cycle: Support the integration, rationalisation and elevation of the risk-resilience cycle by helping to challenge business practices and supporting the simplification and automation of processes, including the adoption of AI tools and techniques.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Banking, Finance or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in the financial services industry is preferred, ideally within banks, financial market infrastructures, regulatory bodies or supervisory authorities. A basic understanding of the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model and first line of defense (1LoD) risk and control responsibilities is expected.
• Initial exposure to or keen interest in at least one of the activities listed under your responsibilities, such as ICS quality, operational risk and controls, audit or supervisory remediation, external assurance, SII and CAP management, integrated control reporting, incidents, claims or resilience-related governance. Prior internship or traineeship experience in a related area is a plus.
• Ability to perform structured analysis, produce clear and accurate deliverables, follow up on tasks reliably and seek guidance proactively. Willingness to learn, ask questions and accept constructive feedback.
• Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarise information clearly and contribute to the preparation of materials for management review.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail, curiosity, pragmatism and a willingness to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. A structured approach to problem-solving is valued.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel, familiarity with SharePoint and collaborative document management, ability to prepare clear presentations, and openness to learning and using AI-based tools and automation in daily work.
• Fluency in spoken and written English is required; German and French are an advantage.

jobs.title: Kapitän (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:


Chemgas Barging S.à r.l., Luxembourg
Inland shipping


Transporting gas on inland waterways in an efficient, reliable and safe manner. That is what we do and what we are good at. Chemgas is the market leader in the transport of pressurized liquefied gases on inland waterways. Our colleagues are committed to this 24/7, all year round. You too can contribute to this! We are looking for a captain for our inland shipping fleet.


What will you do?

As a captain, you provide motivating leadership and this enables you to ensure that our crew and the ship function optimally. You know how to guide your colleagues in the right way, ensure the pleasant working atmosphere on board and promote growth. In the position of captain, you are responsible for the safe, optimal and proper execution of the transport. You carry out your work within the framework of our ship policy and, where necessary, you contribute to improvements. In addition, safety is of paramount importance to you. You help ensure that all (safety) protocols and guidelines on board are complied with.


What ambition do you contribute to?

Chemgas is not standing still, and neither is our inland shipping branch. Our modern and well-maintained fleet is always evolving. We invest a lot of time and energy in new construction and conversion projects. In recent years, our fleet has been expanded with a number of new ships. New construction projects are also planned for the coming years and we are once again rejuvenating our inland shipping fleet. As a result, we are looking for additional talent to strengthen our team.

Partly because of our innovative ships, we strive for the highest achievable. Efficient gas transport for our clients is central and our employees are paramount. With your expertise, you can make an important contribution to this objective.


Are you looking after the vacancy?

You have an eye for safety, the environment and health and you also like to work in a team.


We also ask the following:

You are in possession of a Rhine patent up to at least Mannheim and you can also sail this route independently;
You are willing to obtain your patent up to Iffezheim;
ADN base and willingness to obtain ADN gas;
Radar patent;
VHF certificate;
EU Qualification Certificate.

What do we offer?

Is sailing on the wide rivers and canals in your blood? Are you also looking for a versatile job in inland shipping? Then Chemgas offers you many opportunities for a challenging career. Our inland vessels operate from Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp to Basel. We invest a lot in our employees and our ships. Our fleet is always evolving and equipped according to the latest techniques and innovations. Thanks in part to our motivated crew, there is a positive and enthusiastic atmosphere on board our ships. Expertise, dedication and discipline are paramount. On our inland shipping fleet, we only sail with Dutch-speaking colleagues. Chemgas is a committed company where a lot is possible and your work is appreciated. We focus on internal growth and therefore invest a lot of time in good training and advancement opportunities.

Our barge fleet operates from Luxembourg. Our sailing leave schedule consists of one week on board and one week at home, but two weeks on and two weeks off is also possible. On board you walk in a system of 8 hours on/8 hours. On an annual basis, you have the choice to work 24/28, 25/27 or 26/26 weeks. Would you like to know more about our terms of employment or do you have questions about this? Do not hesitate to contact us and we will be happy to help you!

Finance Manager, EU AMXL
Job ID: 10507726 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The EU AMXL Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to own the financial strategy and controllership within the AMXL Fulfillment space. Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) manages the end-to-end fulfillment of heavy and bulky products — a strategic, high-growth segment for Amazon in Europe, operating across multiple countries with diverse operational and legal frameworks.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a finance leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and shape decisions that affect the long-term economics of the EU AMXL network. The successful candidate will own financial planning and controllership for their area end-to-end, partner directly with Director-level operations and network leaders, and drive strategic analyses that inform multi-year network topology, rate, and investment decisions. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with data, build mechanisms that scale, and bring clarity to ambiguous, complex problems.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Finance & Decision Support:

- Own the financial plan (OP1/OP2/QxG) and long-range outlook for your area, independently building models and scenarios that inform network strategy.
- Lead high-impact analyses (e.g., network topology, rate setting, cost-to-serve, business cases) and present recommendations directly to senior leadership.
- Challenge operational and business partner assumptions with data, providing disruptive ideas where the numbers warrant it.

Business Partnering & Influence:

- Act as the trusted finance partner to Director-level operations, planning, and network leaders, influencing strategic decisions without direct authority.
- Navigate across organizations (e.g., Network, Transportation, Supply Chain, Accounting, Procurement) to align stakeholders and drive outcomes.
- Translate complex financial trade-offs into clear narratives for both Finance and non-Finance senior audiences.

Controllership & Operational Excellence:

- Own financial reporting integrity for your area (month-end close, variance analysis, cost controls), routinely delivering error-free outputs.
- Proactively identify control gaps and risks driven by business, regulatory, or operational change, and design solutions.
- Invent and institutionalize mechanisms (dashboards, automated reporting, planning tools) that scale across the team and network.

Leadership & Force Multiplication:

- Mentor and coach junior analysts, raising the bar on analytical rigor across the team.
- Contribute to the broader Finance community through best-practice sharing, hiring, and development initiatives.
- Identify and drive process improvements that remove bottlenecks and improve decision-making speed across the org.

A day in the life

No two days look the same in AMXL Finance. You might start the morning partnering with an operations leader to pressure-test a network change, spend mid-morning deep in a cost-to-serve model that will shape next year's topology, then present your findings to senior leadership in the afternoon. You'll move fluidly between the detail (validating a cost driver, reconciling a variance) and the big picture (where should we invest, what's the long-term economic story). You'll be the financial voice in the room — challenging assumptions, surfacing risks early, and helping the business make smarter, faster decisions. Expect autonomy, real ownership, and the space to build mechanisms that outlast any single planning cycle.

About the team

We are the EU AMXL Inbound & Middle Mile Finance team — a small, high-trust group of finance professionals supporting one of Amazon's fastest-growing and most operationally complex segments. We own the financials for how heavy and bulky products move through the European network, from inbound and cross-dock through to middle mile transportation. We work closely with operations, planning, and network teams across multiple countries, and we pride ourselves on combining analytical rigor with genuine business partnership. We care about developing our people, learning continuously, and making the work both impactful and enjoyable.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field
- Experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business

- Experience in financial modeling

Description

The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:

• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities

• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders

jobs.description:
Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops Excellence
Job ID: 10503194 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.

The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.

Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job.

Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.

We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.

Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement.

Key job responsibilities

- Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network.
- Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap.
- Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand.
- Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact.
- Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact.
- Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership.
- Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption.
- Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time.

About the team

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience in program or project management, delivering initiatives from concept to execution.
- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or other BI packages.
- Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams, including operations.
- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements.
- Experience with hands-on SQL coding and working with large, complex data sets to design models and scenarios.
- Experience communicating and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including presenting complex, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field.
- Experience in operations, transportation, or supply chain.
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements.
- Experience rolling out tools, processes, or mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.
- Experience with data warehouse architectures, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and analytic tools and environments.
- Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Athena, AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, and IAM.
- Python programming experience for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and basic statistical analysis.
- Experience partnering with technology teams to translate business needs into system requirements and new features.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Bases de données : MySQL et MongoDB

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

Stobart(Part of the Culina Group) is a leading ambient transport and logistics business, providing services to many of the UKs best known brands across core consumer and retail sectors.

We are now recruiting for aShunterto join ourNorthampton, Swan Valleyon a full-time and permanent basis.

Shift Pattern: Working4 on 4 off - 06:00-18:00

Salary:Â£33,509 per annum. Paid Bi-Weekly

Job Description

To ensure the timely trailer movements, on and off loading bays and where applicable to deliver a shunt load from one location to another, as instructed, in line with Company standards and operational requirements.

Key Duties of a Shunter:

  • This role will include inter-depot movements.
  • To place trailers to the required areas as per instructions
  • To use two way radios to keep in contact with areas of the operation as necessary
  • To ensure you carry out all safety checks, as designated by the company.
  • To ensure that you report defects, accident damage and any incidents as soon as they are found.
  • To ensure fridges are set at the correct temperature, in line with loaded product temperature requirements.
  • To ensure fridge diesel tanks have adequate fuel at all times.
  • To always be professional and courteous when communicating with your colleagues.
  • Reporting any breaches in speed limits by drivers and sub contractors to the transport department.
  • Keeping vehicle parking area layouts as they should be and reporting any issues of debris to the site services team
  • Ensure that company standards of hygiene and housekeeping, in your areas of work, are maintained at all times
  • To ensure you are working in line with Health & Safety legislation
Qualifications
  • A Full C+E entitlement is needed for this position.
  • Previous shunting experience
  • Experience of working in a very fast paced environment
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Ability to work to challenging deadlines in a pressurised environment
  • Self disciplined and motivated
Additional Information

As part of our drive to make Stobarta great place to work. We are proud to be an inclusive and diverse organisation where we are committed to employee development and recognising success for hard working performers.

Our dedicated learning and development programmes are open to every employee to give you the opportunity to shape your own future within logistics and continue to work in an environment where team culture thrives.

jobs.title: Wireperson
jobs.description:
Description Trant Te-Tech design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality.
We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton.

The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing.What Youll Be DoingTechnical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring
  • Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling.
  • Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels.
  • Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements.
Technical Support & Collaboration
  • Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings.
  • Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes.
  • Follow work instructions and build documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets.
  • Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency.
  • Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements.
SHE&Q and Compliance
  • Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing.
  • Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies.
  • Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation.
  • Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area.
  • Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times.
Key Interfaces:
Internal Interfaces
  • Workshop Supervisor.
  • Production Manager.
  • Test Engineer.
  • Design & Engineering Teams.
  • Automation Team.
  • Stores / Logistic.
  • Quality Team.
External Interfaces
  • Clients / Inspectors (as required)
  • Suppliers (limited)
Core Values

Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.

What Were Looking ForEssential
  • NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings.
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements.
  • Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies.
  • Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring.
  • Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs.
  • Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment.
  • Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role.
Desirable
  • 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification.
  • Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021.
  • Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems.
  • First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification.
  • Experience wiring MCCs and control panels.
  • Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation.
  • Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults.
  • Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds.
Why Join Trant ?At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day.

Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful.

Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential.

Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference.

Our company benefits package includes:
  • Competitive rates.
  • 28 days holiday (including bank holidays).
  • Options to buy additional holiday via salary sacrifice.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Employee assistance program.
  • Discretionary annual bonus.
Join us and be part of something bigger.

jobs.title: Pokojská - pokojský, Uklízeči a pomocníci v ubytovacích a vzdělávacích zařízeních
jobs.description:
Staňte se součástí hotelu s tradicí od roku 1894. Společně se postaráme o to, aby se hosté cítili jako doma - od prvního pohledu až po poslední detail.

Co vás u nás čeká?
Do našeho týmu hledáme pečlivou a spolehlivou kolegyni (nebo kolegu), která se bude podílet na vytváření příjemného prostředí pro naše hosty. Právě čistota a pořádek jsou jedním z nejdůležitějších důvodů, proč se k nám hosté rádi vracejí.

Vaše role zahrnuje:
- úklid hotelových pokojů, společných prostor hotelu
- spolupráci s recepcí a ostatními kolegy
- péči o čistotu a pořádek podle hotelových standardů

Co od vás očekáváme?
- pečlivost a smysl pro detail
- spolehlivost a zodpovědný přístup k práci
- příjemné vystupování a ochotu pomoci
- schopnost pracovat samostatně i v týmu
- zkušenosti na obdobné pozici jsou výhodou, nikoliv podmínkou

Co nabízíme?
- stabilní zaměstnání v přátelském a téměř "rodinném" týmu
- možnost práce na plný i částečný úvazek
- osmihodinové směny (nástup dle směny od 6:00 nebo od 8:00 hodin)
- práci v příjemném prostředí Wellness hotelu Windsor ve Špindlerově Mlýně
- možnost profesního růstu a rozvoje
- konkurenceschopné ohodnocení

jobs.title: Dělník dokončovny - balič / zkrácený úvazek 4 - 6 hodin/týden, Montážní dělníci výrobků z pryže a plastů
jobs.description:
CO VÁS ČEKÁ?
- Balení laminátových výrobků: vaší hlavní náplní práce bude pečlivé balení laminátových výrobků podle schváleného balicího předpisu. Správné zabalení je klíčové pro ochranu výrobků a zajištění jejich bezpečné manipulace i expedice.
- Finalizace laminátových výrobků: budete provádět dokončovací operace spojené s finalizací výrobků. Důraz bude kladen na preciznost, pečlivé provedení a dodržení stanovených postupů, aby každý kus splňoval požadované kvalitativní standardy.
- Plnění výrobního plánu: vaše práce bude klíčová pro včasné splnění výrobních cílů. Díky vaší pečlivosti a odpovědnému přístupu bude výroba probíhat plynule a efektivně.
- Dodržování technické dokumentace: při práci budete používat přesně předepsané přípravky podle technické dokumentace, což zajistí optimální technologické postupy.
- Samokontrola: budete pravidelně kontrolovat svou práci, aby kvalita odpovídala požadovaným standardům. Váš cit pro detail přispěje k bezchybnému výrobnímu procesu.

CO OD VÁS OČEKÁME?
- Manuální zručnost a fyzická zdatnost: máte šikovné ruce, sílu a chuť pracovat? U nás se vaše dovednosti a preciznost opravdu uplatní! (Bohužel, práce je s těžkými břemeny a tak není vhodná pro ženy.)
- Zkušenosti s broušením - výhoda, ne podmínka: pokud máte zkušenosti s broušením, leštěním nebo kytováním, skvělé! Ale pokud ne, nezoufejte - rádi vás zaučíme přímo na místě. Stačí mít praxi s manuální prací ve výrobě.
- Ochota učit se a rozvíjet dovednosti: máte otevřenou mysl, chuť osvojit si nové techniky a postupy? Každý den se můžete naučit něco nového.
- Práce na zkrácený úvazek: jste flexibilní a ochotni pracovat na zkrácený úvazek v jednosměnném režimu (4 - 6 hod.)? Stabilní pracovní režim je u nás klíčem k efektivitě.
- Pečlivost, zodpovědnost, preciznost: hledáme člověka, který si zakládá na kvalitě odvedené práce, má smysl pro detail a je zodpovědný za své úkoly.

CO VÁM NABÍZÍME?
- Stabilní zaměstnání - Nabízíme hlavní pracovní poměr s možností dlouhodobého růstu.
- Příspěvek na dopravu - Od prvního kilometru se postaráme o váš dojezd.
- Pohodový kolektiv - Pracujte v prostředí, kde se navzájem podporujeme a vytváříme skvělou atmosféru.
- Příspěvek na stravování - Aby vám nikdy nechyběla energie na celý den.
- Volnočasové poukázky - Odpočinek a volný čas jsou u nás také důležité.
- Odměna za využití fondu pracovní doby - Vaše flexibilita a nasazení mají vždy svou hodnotu.
- Zajímavé finanční ohodnocení - Vážíme si vašeho přínosu a to se projevuje i na výplatě.

Zaujala vás tato pozice?
Pošlete nám svůj životopis, budeme se těšit na vaši odpověď.
Tým

jobs.title: Praktisk lageransvarlig til Klosterhedens Vildt A/S
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for vores lager, når vi tager skridtet fra papir til tablet?

Klosterhedens Vildt er en af Danmarks førende leverandører af vildtkød. Vi sælger til private og virksomheder i hele landet, og størstedelen af vores omsætning kommer fra vores egen webshop. Væksten stiller nye krav til lageret — og derfor søger vi en lageransvarlig.

Vi går inden for få uger i luften med elektronisk pluk og pak med tablets og faste lokationer. Vores egenudviklede IT-platform er opdateret og klar. Nu mangler vi den person, der skal få det til at fungere i praksis hver eneste dag.

Lad os slå fast med det samme: det her er ikke et kontorjob. Du er på lageret hver dag, du har hænderne i varerne, og når ordrerne står i kø, pakker du med. Tablet og system er værktøjer — ikke arbejdspladsen.

DET BLIVER DIT ANSVAR

• Den daglige drift af lageret: varemodtagelse, plukning, pakning og forsendelse

• At køre det nye pluk-og-pak-setup ind — lokationsstyring og arbejdsgange på tablets

• At holde styr på lagerbeholdning og lokationer, så data i systemet og virkeligheden på hylden stemmer overens

• Pakkeopgaver på lige fod med resten af holdet, når der er travlt

• Tæt samspil med produktionen, så varerne kommer på hylden til tiden og i rette stand

• Optælling, kvalitetskontrol og overholdelse af fødevare- og temperaturkrav

• Sparring med ledelsen om, hvad der virker, og hvad der skal justeres i platformen

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

• Er struktureret og systematisk — du kan lide, når tingene har en fast plads og en fast rutine

• Har erfaring fra lager, gerne med plukopgaver og lagerstyringssystemer

• Er tryg ved at arbejde digitalt og ikke bange for at lære et nyt system at kende

• Kan holde overblik og tempo i sæsonens travle perioder

• Ikke er bange for at tage fat — du er med på gulvet, ikke bag et skrivebord

Truckkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav — det kan du tage, når du er startet. Erfaring fra fødevare-, køle- eller frostlager er også et plus. Det vigtigste er, at du er ordentlig, mødestabil og har lyst til at tage ejerskab.

VI TILBYDER

• En nøglerolle i en virksomhed i vækst, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling

• Et konkret og synligt projekt: du er med til at sætte de arbejdsgange, vi kommer til at bruge i mange år

• En uformel arbejdsplads med et lille, praktisk team og direkte adgang til ledelsen

• Løn efter kvalifikationer

PRAKTISK

Arbejdssted: Holmgaardvej 49, 7660 Bækmarksbro

Ansættelsestype: Deltid eller fuldtid — vi tilpasser timetallet efter den rette kandidat

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

SÅDAN SØGER DU

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@khv.dk med "Lageransvarlig" i emnefeltet. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette — så send gerne hurtigt.

Se hele stillingen på klosterhedensvildt.dk/job

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til Peter Astrup på 71 80 60 00.

jobs.title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
jobs.description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

Brandom priča je započela prije 20 godina, početkom suradnje dvoje zaljubljenika u poreze, reviziju i knjigovodstvo Branke Topolovec i Domagoja Hladike. Konkretno i objektivno pružamo kompletnu uslugu s područja knjigovodstva, poreznog savjetovanja, obračuna plaća i revizije. Subjektivni pogled i iskustvo svakako donosi najvažniju stranu poslovanja, a to je briga o našim klijentima i individualan pristup svakom zadatku. Naši klijenti su uglavnom hrvatska društva sa stranim vlasništvom. Podrška koju pružamo odnosi se na cjelokupni proces – od osnivanja društva do usluga korištenja poslovne adrese i ureda. Zbog povećanja obujma poslova proširujemo odjel i tražimo dvije osobe koje će nam se pridružiti na radnom mjestu Pripravnik knjigovođa. Pogledajte uvjete natječaja i prijavite se! Veselimo se pojačanju u našem timu. Opis poslova:
  • administrativna i operativna podrška mentoru knjigovođi
  • obavljanje knjiženja ulaznih/izlaznih računa i bankovnih izvoda, usklađenja knjigovodstvene dokumentacije
  • arhiviranje dokumentacije, predaja mjesečnih, kvartalnih i godišnjih izvještaja financijskim institucijama
  • svi ostali knjigovodstveno - računovodstveni poslovi
Uvjeti:
  • stručna sprema - SSS
  • poznavanje rada u MS Office
  • pouzdanost, komunikativnost, odgovornost
  • organizacijske sposobnosti i siguran profesionalni pristup
Nudimo:
  • ugovor na neodređeno s probnim rokom od 6 mjeseci
  • profesionalna usavršavanja i razvoj individualnih kompetencija
  • stimulativna primanja.
Naši stručnjaci oslanjaju se na sveobuhvatno znanje i širinu iskustva dobivenu iz rada s različitim industrijama. Jasno možemo razaznati karakteristike različitih klijenata i tako objektivno pristupiti svakom od njih. Želite li da vaša karijera raste i razvija se uz podršku profesionalaca s dugogodišnjim iskustvom nemojte dvoumiti. Prijavite se!

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

Kako se prijaviti?

Ako prepoznaješ sebe u ovom opisu i želiš postati dio našeg tima, pošalji nam svoj životopis (CV) i kratko motivacijsko pismo na e-mail adresu: ldcagro1@gmail.com s naslovom "Prijava za posao: Sistem inženjer".

jobs.description:
**Traktorinkuljettaja, 2 paikkaa**

**Työtehtävän kuvaus**

Haemme kahta traktorinkuljettajaa monipuolisiin koneurakoinnin, talvikunnossapidon ja maatalousurakoinnin tehtäviin.

Työtehtävät painottuvat erityisesti lumen auraukseen ja talvikunnossapitoon, mutta tehtäviin kuuluu myös muuta koneurakointia sekä maatalousurakointia. Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat vuodenajan sekä työtilanteiden mukaan.

Tehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa:

- lumen auraus ja muu talvikunnossapito

- traktorilla suoritettavat urakointityöt

- maatalousurakoinnin tehtävät

- erilaiset maa- ja kunnossapitotyöt

- työkoneiden ja kaluston huolto- ja kunnossapitotehtävät

- koneiden pienimuotoiset korjaus- ja remonttityöt

- muut yrityksen toimintaan liittyvät koneurakoinnin tehtävät.


**Odotamme hakijalta**

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää aikaisempaa kokemusta traktorilla työskentelystä sekä hyvää ja huolellista koneiden käsittelytaitoa.

Hakijalta edellytämme:

- vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- hyvää työmotivaatiota

- huolellisuutta ja kalustosta huolehtimista

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- joustavuutta vaihtelevissa työtehtävissä ja työolosuhteissa

- valmiutta työskennellä myös talvikauden vaativissa sääolosuhteissa.


**Koneiden ja kaluston huolto-, korjaus- ja remonttitaidot katsotaan merkittäväksi eduksi.** Myös **kaivinkoneen ajotaito sekä aikaisempi kokemus maatalousurakoinnista** katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme käytännönläheistä asennetta sekä halua osallistua monipuolisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin. Tehtävä soveltuu henkilölle, joka viihtyy koneiden parissa ja kykenee työskentelemään sekä itsenäisesti että osana työyhteisöä.

**Tarjoamme**

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn koneurakoinnin ja maatalousurakoinnin parissa. Työtehtävien monipuolisuuden ansiosta työskentelyä on mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös talvikauden ulkopuolella.

Tarjoamme asianmukaiset työvälineet ja kaluston sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista monipuolisten työtehtävien parissa.

Grafik/grafička, Grafici a výtvarníci v multimédiích
jobs.description:
První kontakt e-mailem.

Pro naši centrálu v Brně-Králově Poli hledáme šikovného grafika nebo grafičku, který/á má cit pro vizuál, dobré nápady a hlavně je umí převést do reality.
Co ti můžeme nabídnout
o    zajímavou a různorodou práci s velkým prostorem pro vlastní nápady a seberealizaci
o    nástupní mzdu od 37 100 Kč, po zapracování zapojení do našeho systému bonusů a odměn - výsledné finanční ohodnocení tak můžeš ovlivnit svojí prací a výsledky
o    příjemné pracovní prostředí v Brně-Králově Poli v nové klimatizované budově
o    fajn kolegy a šéfa, se kterým se dá normálně domluvit
o    zázemí stabilní české společnosti s historií více než 20 let
o    MultiSport kartu, slevy na firemní produkty a servis telefonů, neomezený zaměstnanecký tarif s internetem zcela zdarma
o    pracovní dobu od pondělí do pátku od 8:00 do 16:45, případně dle dohody
o    dobrou kávu na pracovišti zdarma
o    možnost nástupu ihned nebo dle dohody
Co bude náplní tvojí práce
o    péče o jednotný vizuální styl naší firmy a jeho další rozvoj
o    tvorba reklamních bannerů, kampaní a další grafiky pro náš web a e-shop
o    návrhy grafiky pro prodejny, výlohy, vitríny, prodejní pulty, plakáty, billboardy i firemní auta
o    příprava grafických podkladů pro tisk a další výrobu
o    produktové focení telefonů, příslušenství a dalšího sortimentu pro náš e-shop
o    úprava a retuš produktových fotografií
o    pravidelná kontrola vizuální podoby našich brněnských prodejen a hledání možností, jak jejich vzhled dál zlepšovat
o    realizace polepů a reklamní grafiky přímo na prodejnách - od návrhu až po finální instalaci
o    spolupráce s kolegy napříč firmou při přípravě akcí, kampaní a dalších projektů
Co od tebe očekáváme
o    cit pro grafiku, detail a jednotný vizuální styl
o    dobré nápady a schopnost dotáhnout je od prvního návrhu až po výsledek
o    samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědnost za odvedenou práci
o    znalost CorelDRAW, Adobe Photoshop a Adobe Lightroom
o    schopnost nafotit produkty tak, aby na našem e-shopu vypadaly atraktivně
o    praktickou zručnost - samolepicí grafiku na výlohu zvládneš nejen navrhnout, ale také správně aplikovat
o    chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady a říct, když vidíš něco, co by šlo udělat lépe
o    spolehlivost a schopnost pracovat samostatně
o    řidičský průkaz skupiny B

Zaujali jsme tě?
Pošli nám svůj životopis s fotografií, krátký průvodní dopis, proč tě tahle práce zaujala, a hlavně několik ukázek své práce nebo odkaz na portfolio na email prace@mobilprovas.cz
Nemusíš nám posílat desítky projektů. Raději vyber pár věcí, na kterých je dobře vidět, co umíš a jakým způsobem přemýšlíš nad grafikou.
Pokud nás tvůj profil a práce zaujmou, ozveme se ti telefonicky a následně tě pozveme na osobní pohovor.

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
multisport karta, zaměstnanecké slevy, neomezený zaměstnanecký tarif s internetem ZDARMA

jobs.title: Residential Valuer
jobs.description:
Introduction:

About The Company

Acumentis is Australia's only independent ASX-listed property valuation and advisory firm. With 350+ team members across 45 locations, we combine national scale with local support and a strong focus on service, inclusion and professional development.

Description:

About The Role

As a Residential Valuer, you will be a key member of our team, collaborating with fellow Valuers and Directors to achieve Acumentis' business objectives and regional goals. Your responsibilities will include:

  • High-Quality Valuations: Deliver valuations of the highest quality, adhering to client and company guidelines, and meeting required service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Market Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of sales trends and market conditions to inform valuation practices.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, contributing to business development initiatives.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Report regularly to the Regional Director and work closely to achieve targeted outcomes.


This position is also open to an Associate Director or Director role for the right candidate.

Skills and Experiences:

About You

Youâll be a great fit for us if:

  • You have a minimum 2 year's relevant experience in residential valuations
  • You possess tertiary qualifications in a relevant Property Degree
  • You have a Certified Practising Valuer (CPV) Qualification
  • You have strong working knowledge of the residential property market in Port Macquarie and surrounding areas.
  • You have a great ability to create and maintain working relationships with clients and colleagues


Weâll be a great fit for you if:

  • Youâd like an extra day of leave for your birthday, study or volunteer opportunities
  • Youâd like to take advantage of employee benefits such as bank partnerships, employee discounts and a full wellness calendar of activities - with new benefits added each month!
  • Youâre looking to join a business with a strong national presence, where relocation can be supported
  • Youâd like a position with a strong client base and steady stream of work
  • Youâd like to ensure your life/work balance through flexible work arrangements
  • Youâd like mentoring from industry leaders to guide your career, and create a guaranteed pathway for our twice-yearly promotion program


It is a condition of employment that staff are to obtain National Police Clearance (paid for by the business).

How To Apply

If working with Acumentis in this period of growth sounds like something you are looking for, please apply online via the link provided. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact the People Team (people@acumentis.com.au). We are unable to consider emailed applications.

Acumentis embraces and values the diversity of culture, working arrangements, sexual orientation and gender identity to ensure our workforce is representative of the community that we work within. We promote a workplace that actively seeks to include and welcome the unique contributions of all people. We embrace and celebrate the value of Indigenous people, their skills and their contribution to our organisation.

jobs.title: Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1145

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

One of the key missions of the Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function is to conduct independent and risk-based investigations to protect the Bank's assets, reputation, and integrity, while ensuring compliance with Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) regulatory requirements.

As a Financial Crime Prevention Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in the detection, assessment, and investigation of potential financial crime risks. This position requires strong regulatory knowledge, excellent interpersonal skills, a genuine investigative mindset, and the ability to navigate complex situations involving AML/CFT, reputational, tax, and other financial crime-related risks.

Your next challenge:

• Review, assess, and investigate cases involving potentially suspicious activity and financial crime concerns.
• Conduct enhanced due diligence, background checks, adverse media reviews, and open-source intelligence research on prospects, clients, counterparties, and transactional parties.
• Analyze customer profiles, account activity, transaction flows, corporate structures, and supporting documentation to identify red flags and assess potential risks.
• Document, structure, and synthesize investigative findings, presenting well-supported assessment to the Compliance Incident Committee (CIC).
• Gather and compile all relevant information required for the preparation and submission of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
• Draft high-quality SARs/STRs based on comprehensive assessments of client activity, transactional behavior, and overall risk exposure.
• Act as a key liaison with the FIU and support responses to regulatory inquiries and requests.
• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Front Office, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to support investigations and manage financial crime risks.
• Keep abreast of evolving financial crime typologies, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Your skills:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Financial Crime Compliance, AML/CFT Investigations, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience dealing with financial crime matters, suspicious activity investigations, and high-risk client relationships.
• Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime typologies, and investigative methodologies.
• Knowledge of banking activities, legal structures, financial products, and client relationships is considered a strong asset.
• Previous experience in Front Office, Credit, Client Relationship Management, or other banking functions would be highly valued.
• Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
• Knowledge of any additional European language would be considered an asset.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Strong investigative mindset with a genuine interest in conducting research and uncovering complex financial crime patterns.
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to connect information from multiple sources and formulate reasoned conclusions.
• Strong synthesis and report-writing abilities.
• Curiosity, resilience, sound judgment, and the confidence to challenge when required.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work autonomously while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of integrity, discretion, and accountability.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
jobs.description:
International Tax Senior Advisor
Locations Luxembourg
Time type Full time
Job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.

You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2–4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

jobs.description:
Career Opportunities: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 24 months) (124470)
Requisition ID 124470 - Posted 31/07/2026 - Luxembourg - Luxembourg - Activity area (1) - Experienced Professionals

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Technology & Operations design and integrate software applications ranging from portfolio management systems, trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group's key innovations while sustaining business operations and developing custodian and funds administration services.

This function is in the Clients & Assets Services department, in the Asset Data Management unit.

Your role

As a Banking Operations Officer, you will be responsible for overseeing the opening and pricing of a diverse range of financial products. This includes a wide scope of assets, such as listed products (equities, bonds, loans, derivatives), OTC products (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD), and structured products (autocall, reverse convertible, dual currency deposits, accumulators, airbags). You will manage the entire workflow, from trade reception and integration into the bank's database, through lifecycle management, to instrument pricing.

Another aspect of the role will be to manage our complex platform and its development, working closely with our Product Analyst.

• Integrate and control asset openings on our global platform, Neoxam.
• Monitor and publish asset data, prices, Greeks, market data, and analytics across all supported platforms.
• Manage the lifecycle of all assets from an asset data perspective (Corpac events, openings, unwinds).
• Provide support to various users of this data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge various asset types against counterparty prices.
• Liaise directly with key stakeholders in case of issues.
• Implement the necessary configurations for queries and data/pricing flows for newly registered securities from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).
• Regularly review and update these settings.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years' experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

Hard skills:

• Strong understanding on financial products.
• Solid technical skills, particularly with data management tools and financial platforms.
• Background in mathematical finance.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.
• Programming skills: VBA, SQL or another language is an asset.

Soft skills:

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects with versatility in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with various teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.


Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion
Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist - Island of Ireland (Restaurator/in im Steinmetz- und Steinbildhauerhandwerk/Master Professional für Restaurierung im Handwerk)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

This role requires residence in the Repub

jobs.title: Support Systems Lead (NYC)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Systems Lead at Replit, you'll build and own the systems that let support scale as fast as the product does. You'll own the tools our team works in every day, the technical setup behind self-service and AI-driven support, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it current as Replit ships.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You'll shape how our support systems adapt to new products, new surfaces, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and turning ad hoc fixes into infrastructure the whole team can rely on.

You'll combine hands-on technical depth with systems thinking to keep builders moving, whether they get unblocked through self-service, an AI agent, or a person. This is an individual contributor role to start, with room to grow and build out a team as support scales.



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Configure and maintain Zendesk and the surrounding support stack, from the day-to-day workflow and automation setup to business rules and permissions, keeping it able to flex and scale as needs change.

 - Build and maintain assignment logic, queues, tagging and taxonomy, and escalation paths, keeping them running cleanly as volume and workflows change.

 - Set up and maintain support tooling, workflows, and access across internal agents, outsourced vendors, and regions, keeping the systems working for each group as the stack changes.

 - Partner with Engineering on the technical requirements for self-service and in-product support surfaces, and build the entry points, help widgets, and routing behind them.

 - Spot the repetitive steps in agent and admin workflows before they become bottlenecks, and build the automations, bulk actions, and scripts, including in Replit, that take them out.

 - Take in tooling and systems requests from across support, run tool and vendor evaluations for the support stack, and lead a migration if we change platforms.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years in support operations, support systems, tooling, or a similar technical operations role.

 - Hands-on administration of a ticketing platform like Zendesk: building triggers and automations, macros, views, and SLAs, and managing routing, groups, and permissions.

 - Experience building and maintaining integrations across SaaS tools using APIs and webhooks.

 - Comfortable troubleshooting directly and working with engineers on more complex system needs.

 - Strong judgment about prioritization in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments.

 - Comfort taking on cross-functional problems, including ones that sit between support, tooling, and engineering



NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Scripting with Python or similar to build automations, bulk actions, and internal tooling.

 - Experience standing up self-service or in-product support surfaces.

 - Experience making systems work across both BPO and in-house teams.

 - Zendesk certification.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Interviewing + Culture at Replit
